description: Check what Research Triggers can do before you design one. Use this when you are about to decide who gets invited. Supported: one event, an exact property or trait match, a URL rule, and page dwell. Unsupported: counts, sequences, absence, time windows, and not-equals. If the condition you need is unsupported, send interview_link instead of calling create_research_trigger. This does not create a trigger.
name: get_trigger_capabilities
title: Get trigger capabilities
